title: %parseInt — parse string to integer with radix
purpose: Parse a string into an integer using an explicit numeric base.
notes: The radix is optional and defaults to 10; here base 16 parses "FF" to 255.
A radix must be between 2 and 36, otherwise the result is null (~).

avoid.why: without a radix the default base 10 is used, so a hex string like "FF" parses to null (~) rather than 255
